text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! It takes more than 4 hours?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break. I turned 
around after hearing a familiar scream—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria was sitting around a table, 
lively and laughing with her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis, Loves Only You, Curren 
Bouquetd'or. All of them are Umamusume 
from the same generation as Gran Alegria."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Hanshin Racecourse is in Hyogo 
Prefecture. We will need to transfer to a 
local line from Shin-Osaka Station.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Here are the route directions. Go 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, the travel outside the bullet train 
is pretty long. Lots of transfers. Think 
it'd be better to pack light?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Luggage? Do you really need that much? 
It's just a day trip, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm bringing a full camera kit to shoot 
videos, but it all fit into a single bag.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I want to film everyone before 
departure, and scenes of us eating at the 
restaurant. Thanks for cooperating with 
the shoot♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed their conversation was about the 
field trip to this weekend's Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since everyone is targeting the Oka Sho 
next year, a trip was arranged to watch in 
person and study up. I will be escorting 
them to Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan, I can help you pack if you'd 
like. What's taking up so much space?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Could that be— luggage related to your 
personal rules?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But they'd just get in the way, 
so... I'll leave everything behind except 
for my radio to relax.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Are you bringing that huge radio 
with you!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you just listen to online radio 
on your smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I don't like headphones. I can't relax if 
my ears are covered.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. You listen to the radio to 
relax, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Um. In that case— how about bone 
conduction earphones?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan introduced it on UmaStagram 
before. If you'd like, I could borrow it 
for you...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds really good! Bouquet-san, 
I wanna borrow that♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will bring it tomorrow then.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I can travel light for the 1.3 miles 
tomorrow, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria and the others continued to 
talk excitedly about the field trip after 
that, just like kids before a school 
outing.
choice_data_list:
(Looks like it's going to be lively on the 
day itself!)

(Looks like it's going to be lively on the 
day itself!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The weekend. Aboard the Shinkansen bound 
for Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...So you were putting pickled plums into 
your Hachimi, huh.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Hey everyone, would it be okay if I 
talked about what we bought just now on my 
fan community?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of course, go right ahead! I have no 
off-limit topics. Ask away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You is planning to share 
stories from the tour with her fan 
community.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently she got filming permission 
beforehand from the restaurant where they 
shot the dining scene. What a reliable 
girl!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, are you all right on drinks?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu—Chrono-san looks like she's having 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis has been browsing 
newspapers and racing info sites all 
morning long...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...When it comes to maiden races in the 
Classic Year, girls who have run fewer 
races tend to have higher win rates. 
Taking their previous race results into 
account as well—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"That's Chrono-chan's 'Genesis Method,' 
right? I wonder if your winning Umamusume 
prediction will come true!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she was reading through all the 
newspapers until late last night.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Number 8 is a solid bet for first place. 
The real question is the contender... 
Number 1, Number 3... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is, but... what's your 
prediction, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because you're the expert, right? 
You come up with race strategies and 
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I haven't studied the 
competing Umamusume, so I can't say for 
sure. However, if I had to point out one 
thing..."
choice_data_list: No. 4 is one to keep an eye on too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see. Number 4 has switched back 
from short distance to the mile.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Her total number of starts is piling up, 
but finishing 3rd in her previous race 
after a layoff is a positive factor.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this... looks like it'll definitely 
reach!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... O-Oh no. Me again...! I-It's post 
time, so let's check our answers...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I hope everyone can reach the 
goal without any injuries.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well then, as for me... it's my personal 
rule: "Relaxation time with Diet broadcast 
on the radio"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, spending their time however they 
pleased, they eventually arrived at 
Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Finally got a spot where I can see! 
1.8 Mile is way too crowded!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...The fan favorite is... Ah, Lara-san 
after all. It's only natural, really..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She won the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, and 
conquered the trial Tulip Sho as well. 
Judging from her last race too...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Chrono-chan! ...Chrono-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! S-S-So sorry! I-I got carried away 
again...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, can you explain it to us too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Well then... p-pardon me while I 
provide commentary... The 2nd favorite is 
Ai-san. This is likely—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"They say Umamusume who place in the top 
two at the Shinzan Kinen perform well at 
the Oka Sho... Perhaps having that track 
record gives her a bit of an extra 
edge...?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that so! I wonder if it applies 
this time too—I'm so curious~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to Chrono-chan, the fun level went 
up by 5 miles!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-It's really nothing more than a hobby of 
mine, but... Thank you, you're too kind...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Lucky Lilac! She's the 
undefeated 4-race Junior queen, after all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Her win in the Tulip Sho was 
completely decisive, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Graceful and persevering, Lucky Lilac. 
Fiercely competitive, Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them are a generation above 
Gran Alegria and the others, their seniors 
at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Evaluation... I'm losing. To Lala...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to lose... not at a single 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Are you saying her performance in the 
Shinzan Kinen wasn't enough to make up for 
her track record?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is strong, but she's coming off 
a break... I'd say Lucky Lilac is the one 
to bet on, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Ai, don't you think it's a bit too early?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If you get so fired up this early on, 
you're gonna end up rushing and losing 
your cool.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Better than a late start! Even if I pull 
too hard, I'll hold on to the end!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even if it hurts, even if my lungs give 
out, I won't stop running until the finish 
line! Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The one who wins is me!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case—I'll have to give it 
my all too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...! I just got chills...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, they both have incredible fighting 
spirit...!

Yeah, both of them have unbelievable 
drive...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, into the final stretch! Lucky Lilac 
has taken the lead here!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And here comes Almond Eye from the far 
outside! Almond Eye comes flying down the 
outside!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye passes them all at once and 
crosses the finish line! Crowned the Queen 
of the Cherry Blossoms is Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I... I did it! I really did it! I won the 
Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala had such a brilliant start, it gave 
me a chill for just a second!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How the race played out after that wasn't 
bad at all. Yep!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, Almond Eye-san. I was 
completely outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Lara!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I lost this time, but the Oaks is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I won't back down. Not for the Oaks, 
not for the Shuka Sho—not for any of them.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Not to you, not to anyone. I won't lose—!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, Ai-san is just so Ai-san, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...No way... Can she really close the gap 
from that far back...?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai, what an incredible finishing 
kick! A 60-mile burst of speed!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! That time... It's an Oka Sho 
record!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! A new record... She beat the time set by 
that Triple Tiara Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A record, huh! That sounds awesome!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna aim for it next year too! I'll 
beat Ai-senpai's time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because it's a mile race! I can 
definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-Is it because... it's a mile race...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The mile is my distance!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai took quite a while to reach top 
speed... So I think I have the edge when 
it comes to explosive acceleration!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A difference in stamina doesn't matter in 
a mile race. They're both fast!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
See! With my explosive burst of speed, I 
can set a faster time!
choice_data_list: True, you do have a point...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Next year, let's set a record! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so full of confidence strangely 
made me feel like it really might be 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh, just as expected of 
Gran-chan. You're right, this is no time 
to be overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still—did you forget? We're aiming for the 
Oka Sho too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't... surrender the Tiara... or the 
victory either...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Surviving the winter, until the buds of 
spring sprout. I want to nurture—and 
deliver it. A bouquet of cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! Then next year—at the Oka 
Sho, we settle this!
